title: Access visibility in subclasses
answer: Subclass access depends on the member's access modifier. Public members are accessible wherever the type is visible; protected members are accessible in the same package and through subclass rules; package-private members are limited to the package; private members are not directly accessible by subclasses. AeroTopo keeps Product fields private, exposes protected constructors for subclasses, and provides public methods such as `id()`, `tiles()`, and `resolutionMetres()` as the controlled subclass/client boundary.
